title: Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024: first stage
excerpt: SUPER CUP ATTP SUMMER 2024: Stage I
body_html:
The first stage of the national table tennis tournament Super Cup ATTP – Summer 2024

The prize-winners of groups A-F in the first stage are:

Group F

I Daniel Batrîncea

II Liviu Doloșcan

III Oleg Cotorcea

Group E

I Petru Capbătut

II Vitalie Plescaci

III Mihai Filip

Group D

I Alexandr Cosogolov

II Alexei Tarasov

III Evgenii Zotov

Group C

I Pavel Brighidin

II Sergiu Nazaria

III Ion Nuca

Group B

I Oleg Medînschii

II Ivan Maximenco

III Valentin Mihailov

Group A

I Cristian Tudorean

II Daniel Belibov

III Petru Bulat

It was a remarkable and emotional stage of the tournament. We are grateful to everyone who took part in this fine event.

Congratulations to the winners, and thank you for your excellent play and glorious victories!
